title: Stop making this Meta ads mistake
description: Stop making this Meta ads mistake
transcript: What's the biggest beginner mistake you see people make? I think a lot of beginners will try and create ads just like the other ads that they see people make in their industry. And if it's a small business, a brand new business, there's no differentiation there. They're competing against other businesses that have more establishment, more brand. And if you're just advertising in the same way, offering the same thing, almost no one's gonna buy your thing or inquire for your service in comparison to those larger competitors. So beginners need to find a way to differentiate themselves. Often more than larger established brands do. You want to model from the business that's a year or two ahead of where you are now and they've gone on the journey that you'd like to go on. They will still need to do things differently and find ways to compete with their larger competition. So you can model from that, but yeah, don't go and try and model the Goliath that's been there forever.
